title: Multimodal neurons in artificial neural networks
summary: We’ve discovered neurons in CLIP that respond to the same concept whether presented literally, symbolically, or conceptually. This may explain CLIP’s accuracy in classifying surprising visual renditions of concepts, and is also an important step toward understanding the associations and biases that CLIP and similar models learn.
body: We’ve discovered neurons in CLIP that respond to the same concept whether presented literally, symbolically, or conceptually. This may explain CLIP’s accuracy in classifying surprising visual renditions of concepts, and is also an important step toward understanding the associations and biases that CLIP and similar models learn.
summaryZh: OpenAI在CLIP模型中发现了多模态神经元，这些神经元无论概念以文字、符号还是视觉形式呈现，都能被激活。这一发现解释了CLIP在分类意料之外的视觉演绎时的准确性，也是理解多模态模型关联与偏见的重要一步。
